Effect & icon catalog

Keys from STS_CARDS_DB.json iconCatalog when present, else the built-in fallback. In-card clusters prepend conditional, AoE, or random when *.conditioned, attack text says all enemies, or discardEffect.random (etc.). Base numbers stay in the stat row (damage shows weak / vuln / both); AoE attacks get one shared rose tint behind modifiers + damage. Orbs, exhaust, and debuff stacks use the keys below.

Database icon keys

  • LIGHTNING_ORB

    Lightning orb (channel / evoke visuals)

  • FROST_ORB

    Frost orb

  • DARK_ORB

    Dark orb

  • PLASMA_ORB

    Plasma orb

  • DRAW_ICON

    Draw from draw pile

  • DISCARD_ICON

    Discard to discard pile

  • EVOKE_ICON

    Evoke orb

  • CONDITIONAL_MARKER

    Effect is conditional (paired with draw, energy, etc.)

  • ANY_ORB

    Generic orb placeholder when color not fixed

  • SAME_ORB_AS_EVOKED

    Echo orb type from prior evoke

  • AOE_ICON

    Hits all enemies (paired with damage icon)

  • RANDOM_ICON

    Random choice (e.g. discard target)

  • AOE_DAMAGE

    AoE damage

  • EXHAUST_SELF

    Exhaust (self)

Card stat row (gallery)

Same icons as the main planner card: primary value plus side columns where applicable.

  • Damage

    Lightning: base damage.

    Down arrow / alert / dumbbell: damage under weak, vulnerable, and both.

    damageweakvulnerablestrength

  • Block

    Shield: block. Struck shield: value under frail.

    blockfrail

  • Draw

    Page icon + count.

    draw

  • Energy

    Lightning + energy gain value.

    energygain

  • HP loss

    Self-hit when takeDamage is present.

    takedamage
